seo_description: Sharp Story is an independent branding and packaging studio for D2C and FMCG brands. How we think and how we work.
heading:
One habit:
cutting.
lead: Sharp Story is an independent branding and packaging studio. We help D2C and FMCG brands build brands that are clear in purpose, distinct on shelf and on screen, and made to last.
statement: A brand is a promise you can say in one sentence.
story: Most brands don’t struggle from having too little to say. They struggle from saying too much: a purpose, three taglines and a look borrowed from the category leader. Our work starts by taking things away.

We combine research, strategic thinking and purposeful creativity. We listen first, find the one idea a brand can own, then build the identity and packaging around it, so every detail points the same way.
We’re independent by choice. The people you meet are the people doing the work, and we take on a small number of projects so each one gets our full attention.

audiences.title: D2C brands
audiences.text: Founders launching or growing a product brand who need it to stand out in a crowded feed, a marketplace grid and a quick-commerce thumbnail.

audiences.title: FMCG and family businesses
audiences.text: Established brands with real distribution and a range that has grown faster than its packaging. We bring the system back without losing the recall.

principles.title: Research first
principles.text: Good branding starts with what’s true about the business, the market and the people it serves. We find that before we design anything.

principles.title: One idea
principles.text: A brand that says one thing clearly will beat one that says everything. We find the idea worth owning and cut the rest.

principles.title: Purposeful craft
principles.text: Every colour, word and fold should earn its place. Restraint is harder than decoration, and it lasts longer.

principles.title: Built to grow
principles.text: We design systems, not one-offs, so the brand holds up from the first pack to the hundredth product.

process.title: Listen
process.text: Workshops, interviews and research into the business, the category and the customer.

process.title: Cut
process.text: Purpose, positioning and the one idea the brand will own, agreed before design begins.

process.title: Shape
process.text: Identity and packaging designed together as one system, and tested where the brand will live.

process.title: Launch
process.text: Guidelines, files and support, so your team can keep the brand sharp without us.
